diagnosis: Small cell neuroendocrine carcinoma (SCNEC) of the breast
legend: SCNEC shows uniform, small, dark, hyperchromatic cells with a high N:C ratio, scant cytoplasm, and necrosis.

diagnosis: Small cell neuroendocrine carcinoma (SCNEC) of the breast
Small cell neuroendocrine carcinoma (SCNEC) of the breast
legend: Focal nuclear expression of TTF1 in primary SCNEC of the breast.

diagnosis: Invasive breast carcinoma with neuroendocrine morphology (ex large cell neuroendocrine carcinoma)
legend: Cells show evident cytoplasm and highly pleomorphic nuclei.

diagnosis: Invasive breast carcinoma with neuroendocrine morphology (ex large cell neuroendocrine carcinoma)
Mixed small cell and invasive lobular carcinoma
legend: Small cell carcinoma composed of malignant cells with hyperchromatic nuclei and scant cytoplasm merges with sheets of slightly dyscohesive cells of invasive lobular carcinoma.

diagnosis: Mixed small cell and invasive lobular carcinoma
legend: Higher magnification of mixed small cell and invasive lobular carcinoma shows small cell carcinoma insinuating among invasive lobular carcinoma cells.

diagnosis: Metastatic lobular and small cell carcinoma
legend: Axillary lymph node biopsy in a patient with metastatic ER-positive breast cancer. The metastasis shows a mixed lobular and small cell carcinoma.

diagnosis: Metastatic lobular and small cell carcinoma
legend: ER is expressed in the metastatic lobular carcinoma cells but not in the small cell carcinoma component.

diagnosis: Metastatic lobular and small cell carcinoma
legend: GATA3 immunohistochemistry decorates lobular carcinoma cells adjacent to and admixed with small cell carcinoma.

diagnosis: Metastatic lobular and small cell carcinoma
legend: Synaptophysin is expressed in the small cell carcinoma component, but is absent in the metastatic lobular carcinoma cells.

diagnosis: Small cell neuroendocrine carcinoma (NEC) of the breast
legend: Nested tumour clusters with an area of necrosis. Tumour cells show dark hyperchromatic nuclei with inconspicuous nucleoli and nuclear moulding. There is scant cytoplasm with a high N:C ratio.

diagnosis: Small cell neuroendocrine carcinoma (NEC) of the breast
legend: Tumour cells are diffusely positive for chromogranin immunostaining.

diagnosis: Small cell neuroendocrine carcinoma of the breast
legend: Tumour cells are diffusely positive for synaptophysin immunostaining.

diagnosis: Small cell neuroendocrine carcinoma (NEC) of the breast
legend: Tumour cells can also be positive for TTF1 (usually not diffuse distribution nor strong intensity), which can be observed in extrapulmonary small cell NEC, though a metastatic origin from the lung needs to be ruled out, especially in this case with diffuse and relatively intense nuclear expression.

diagnosis: In situ and infiltrating small cell neuroendocrine carcinoma (NEC) of the breast
legend: Intraductal solid growth of tumour cells showing dark hyperchromatic nuclei with unremarkable nucleoli and nuclear moulding as in the invasive counterpart.

diagnosis: In situ and infiltrating small cell neuroendocrine carcinoma (NEC) of the breast
legend: Tumour cells of in situ and infiltrating small cell NEC of the breast are diffusely positive for chromogranin immunostaining.

diagnosis: In situ and infiltrating small cell neuroendocrine carcinoma (NEC) of the breast
legend: Diffuse positivity for synaptophysin immunostaining in both components.

diagnosis: In situ and infiltrating small cell neuroendocrine carcinoma of the breast
legend: The nuclei of tumour cells in both components are intensely positive for TTF1 immunostaining.
